title: Collection Supply Allowances — Physician Client Accounts
content:
Collection supplies for Physician Client Accounts are limited, in every account class, to collecting and shipping specimens to the laboratory. The class decides which items may be ordered, how far apart two supply orders must be and how many supply items one order may carry.

## Items the account may order

| Supply item | Independent Practice Client Account | Group Practice Client Account | Multispecialty Medical Group Account | Federally Qualified Health Center Account | Hospital Outreach Reference Account | Occupational Health Employer Account |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Requisition forms | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Specimen transport bags | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Vacutainer tubes, SST | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Vacutainer tubes, EDTA | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Urine cups | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Swab collection kits | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Refrigerated transport boxes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |

## Ordering allowances

| Account class | Calendar days that must separate two supply orders | Supply items per order (maximum) | Supplies for laboratory use only |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 7 | 8 | Yes |
| Group Practice Client Account | 7 | 10 | Yes |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 7 | 15 | Yes |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 7 | 12 | Yes |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 3 | 20 | Yes |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 30 | 4 | Yes |

## Notes

- "Laboratory use only" means the supplies may be used only to collect and ship specimens to the laboratory; it applies in every class.
- The Hospital Outreach Reference Account orders the narrowest set of item types (requisition forms, specimen transport bags and refrigerated transport boxes) but may order most often, every 3 calendar days, and with the most items per order, 20.
- The Occupational Health Employer Account may order requisition forms and urine cups only, at most 4 items per order, with 30 calendar days between orders.
- Refrigerated transport boxes are not on the Independent Practice Client Account list.
